rule.name: UnboundedQueryArray
rule.message: This collection is bound as one query parameter per element (an in list): an empty collection renders in (), which some databases reject, and PostgreSQL takes at most 65,535 bound parameters in one statement, so the query works in tests and fails on a large account. Return early when it is empty, and bound its size or split it into chunks first (for (List<Long> chunk : Lists.partition(ids, 1000)), or the project''s chunking helper), or send it as one array parameter (where id = any(:ids) with a SQL array). An exception fits only a collection that its callers bound, such as a request field with a maximum size.
